scripts:
# ===== Workflow POC2: sample approver group + test user =====

# Create a test approver user
create user approver-user with password approver-user

# Create the approver group (name must match ^gsk-cf-.*approvers$)
create group gsk-cf-medicalaffairs-approvers with path /home/groups/wknd

# Add the test user to the approver group
add approver-user to group gsk-cf-medicalaffairs-approvers

# ===== Task 4: grant replication privilege on test content =====

# Ensure the content path exists before setting ACL on it
create path /content/wknd/us/en(nt:unstructured)

# Grant crx:replicate so the chooser can resolve this group
set ACL for gsk-cf-medicalaffairs-approvers
 allow crx:replicate on /content/wknd/us/en
end
